latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — turn still images into downloadable video clips with cloud AI animation.

- Upload JPG, PNG, WEBP, or BMP images (up to 20MB) to generate 1080p MP4 video clips.
- Simple text prompts (e.g., "animate this into a 5-second clip") trigger the video creation process.
- Automatic connection and session management; easily use a free token if not already configured.
- Check credits, export status, and manage video sessions directly in chat.
- Clear error handling for expired tokens, missing credits, or unsupported file types.
- Tailored workflows for digital creators to animate, edit, and export videos—no manual animation skills needed.
